module origen_018002 #(parameter BIT_SZ = 14)
(
    input sysclk,
    input trigger,
    input [BIT_SZ-1:0] N,
    output reg [14:0] N_out,
    output [4:0] ledr,
    output time_out,
    output reg [1:0] state
);

    localparam IDLE = 2'b00;
    localparam COUNTING = 2'b01;
    localparam TIME_OUT = 2'b10;
    localparam WAIT_LOW = 2'b11;

    reg [BIT_SZ-1:0] count;
    reg count_on;
    reg [13:0] random_delay;

    assign time_out = (state == TIME_OUT);

    always @(posedge sysclk) begin
        case (state)
            IDLE: begin
                if (trigger) begin
                    state <= COUNTING;
                    count <= N - 1;
                end
            end
            COUNTING: begin
                if (count == 0) begin
                    state <= TIME_OUT;
                    N_out <= count;
                end else begin
                    count <= count - 1;
                end
            end
            TIME_OUT: begin
                if (!trigger) begin
                    state <= IDLE;
                end else begin
                    state <= WAIT_LOW;
                end
            end
            WAIT_LOW: begin
                if (!trigger) begin
                    state <= IDLE;
                end
            end
            default: state <= IDLE;
        endcase
    end

endmodule
